findings.title: A session still counts as valid during its expiry second
findings.description: `Session::is_expired` returns `now > self.expires_at`, so a session is not expired at `now == expires_at`. The doc comment above it says a session that expires at second `n` is valid for none of second `n`. Found by reading the code; no test was run.

findings.title: Header names looked up with a short-circuiting comparison
findings.description: `Request::header` finds the `Authorization` header through `find`, which compares each header name with `==`. That comparison returns at the first byte that differs, so how long a lookup takes depends on the names the client sent. Header names are not secret, so this may reveal nothing; it needs a measurement to rule out.
findings.fix: None needed unless a measurement shows the lookup time reveals something the client does not already know.
